incidents.description: A purchasing bot at the fictional firm Example Logistics raised its standing order each time the supplier's pricing bot raised its price, and the pricing bot raised the price each time orders rose. Over two days the loop multiplied the order book twentyfold before a person stopped it.
incidents.title: TEST CASE: Fictional buyer and seller bots at Example Logistics drive a reorder spiral
